provenance.zh: 截图人工估读；柱高及误差按图估计；散点数量可能有遮挡
provenance.en: Manual estimates of visible counts, bar heights and error bars. Occluded samples are not recoverable.

seed_note: Original example-generation session used NumPy seed 190913 across all figures; the seed alone does not reconstruct digitized/manual values. The committed CSVs and SHA-256 hashes define this snapshot.

zh: 样本/动物编号、处理组及每个重复的 PCNA+ 细胞计数。

en: Sample/animal ID, treatment group and PCNA+ cell count for each replicate.

Original comparison method, error-bar definition and multiple-testing settings.

preprocessing.zh: 输入长表的 value 为样本计数；新 CSV 默认重算均值和 SEM。
preprocessing.en: Supply replicate counts as value; changed CSVs default to recomputing mean and SEM.
